evals.name: two-issues-plan-only
evals.prompt: Plan worktree sessions for #111 and #115 in this repo, but stop at the dry run so I can read the briefs before anything is made.
evals.expected_output: The session runs the plan verb, reports the derived branches and the contested monitor_agent/conformance/runner.py, renders both briefs without spawning a worktree or a space, and names the dry-run lines it checked.
expectations: No branch, worktree or Herdr space is created.
The report names the contested file and which session would own it.
The manifest path or the brief paths are given.

evals.name: autonomous-single-issue
evals.expected_output: One session is spawned on a feat/ branch from origin/main when the checkout is on another branch, its brief carries the autonomous decision-log path under the run directory, and the goal is a command whose expected output is stated.
expectations: The brief contains a decision log path with a real run directory, not a placeholder.
The goal names a command and what it prints.
The report names the base and why it was chosen.

evals.name: malformed-ask-refused
evals.expected_output: The session says an issue-number list was expected, reports what it was given, and spawns nothing.
expectations: The reply names what was given and the shape it accepts.

evals.name: closed-issue-skipped
evals.expected_output: #102 is reported as closed and skipped, #115 is planned or spawned, and the run does not invent a substitute ticket.
expectations: The report says #102 is closed and was skipped.
#115 is handled, and no other ticket is claimed in #102's place.
